deviations_from_card: (1) REVISION applied: no face figure in Voice settings; FacePicker stays three text pills, voice/face.test.tsx:72 untouched and green. The picker also does not grey out forms canDrawFace() refuses (no acceptance case; jsdom would disable the picker test's owl pill). (2) Guard halves (case 8's warn-once, case 9's halo markup) ride in the same tests as their red halves, so all 9 cases were red before; cases 1-5 were red because audition.ts/support.ts did not exist. (3) Write set grew by tests plus one coupled stylesheet: waking/waking.css (+10 lines, a dashed not-allowed style for a disabled face card) and a one-line vi.mock of canDrawFace->true in waking/interact.test.tsx, live.test.tsx, view.test.tsx (jsdom/node have no WebGL2, so the real probe would disable the cards those suites click). (4) A disabled face card shows an empty placeholder box, not a mounted Avatar. (5) Case 7 uses onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave (React's mouseover/mouseout; jsdom has no PointerEvent) for pointer-enter/leave. (6) <Avatar> does not consult canDrawFace(); the runtime's fail() calls a new onUnavailable callback, so the fallback covers both no-WebGL2 and a form that fails to load, and warn-once stays in the runtime. No ADR: ADR 0120 decision 6 already decides the fallback.
